# RNG scope: Labour Quotas rise to tier temp wif_rng_lq (never fall; The Reluctant Servant caps
# them at tier 2). Japan's Chinese Labour follows.
wif_rng_labour_raise = {
	if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_rng_reluctant_servant check_variable = { wif_rng_lq > 2 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_lq = 2 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lq > wif_rng_lq_cur } }
		set_variable = { wif_rng_lq_cur = wif_rng_lq }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_rng_labour_1 } remove_ideas = wif_rng_labour_1 } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_rng_labour_2 } remove_ideas = wif_rng_labour_2 } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_rng_labour_3 } remove_ideas = wif_rng_labour_3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lq_cur = 1 } } add_ideas = wif_rng_labour_1 } if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lq_cur = 2 } } add_ideas = wif_rng_labour_2 } if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lq_cur = 3 } } add_ideas = wif_rng_labour_3 }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = JAP }
			JAP = {
				if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_jap_labour_1 } remove_ideas = wif_jap_labour_1 } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_jap_labour_2 } remove_ideas = wif_jap_labour_2 } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_jap_labour_3 } remove_ideas = wif_jap_labour_3 }
				if = { limit = { RNG = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lq_cur = 1 } } } add_ideas = wif_jap_labour_1 } if = { limit = { RNG = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lq_cur = 2 } } } add_ideas = wif_jap_labour_2 } if = { limit = { RNG = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lq_cur = 3 } } } add_ideas = wif_jap_labour_3 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# JAP scope: The China Dividend / The China Burden follow RNG's Economic Decay as Japan sees it.
wif_jap_china_update = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_jap_china_dividend_1_idea } remove_ideas = wif_jap_china_dividend_1_idea } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_jap_china_dividend_2_idea } remove_ideas = wif_jap_china_dividend_2_idea } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_jap_china_burden_idea } remove_ideas = wif_jap_china_burden_idea } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_jap_china_burden_hard_idea } remove_ideas = wif_jap_china_burden_hard_idea }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = RNG RNG = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_tree is_subject_of = JAP } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_t_view = RNG.wif_rng_decay }
		if = {
			limit = { RNG = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_cooked_books NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_decay_locked } } }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_t_view = 10 }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_view < 25 } } add_ideas = wif_jap_china_dividend_1_idea }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_view < 50 } } add_ideas = wif_jap_china_dividend_2_idea }
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_t_view > 74.999 } }
			if = { limit = { RNG = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_cooked_books } } add_ideas = wif_jap_china_burden_hard_idea }
			else = { add_ideas = wif_jap_china_burden_idea }
		}
	}
}

# PRC scope: The Blockade eases one tier - never below tier 2 while the Northwestern Army
# tightens it and holds Guyuan.
wif_prc_blockade_ease = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_prc_blockade_3 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_prc_blockade_3 add_idea = wif_prc_blockade_2 } }
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = wif_prc_blockade_2 NOT = { wif_prc_blockade_held = yes } }
		swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_prc_blockade_2 add_idea = wif_prc_blockade_1 }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_prc_blockade_1 } remove_ideas = wif_prc_blockade_1 }
}
wif_prc_blockade_remove = {
	if = {
		limit = { wif_prc_blockade_held = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_prc_blockade_3 } swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_prc_blockade_3 add_idea = wif_prc_blockade_2 } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_prc_blockade_1 } remove_ideas = wif_prc_blockade_1 } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_prc_blockade_2 } remove_ideas = wif_prc_blockade_2 } if = { limit = { has_idea = wif_prc_blockade_3 } remove_ideas = wif_prc_blockade_3 }
	}
}

# Either side: once both chose A New United Front, it happens (once).
wif_chn_united_front_check = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_chn_united_front }
			country_exists = PRC country_exists = CHI
			PRC = { has_country_flag = wif_prc_united_front }
			CHI = { has_country_flag = wif_nwa_united_front }
		}
		set_global_flag = wif_chn_united_front
		PRC = {
			diplomatic_relation = { country = CHI relation = non_aggression_pact active = yes }
			wif_prc_blockade_ease = yes
		}
	}
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Communist Guerrillas (com)
# RNG scope: strength += temp wif_rng_d, never below 10 or above the cap.
wif_rng_com_add = {
	add_to_variable = { wif_rng_com_s = wif_rng_d }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_s < 10 } } set_variable = { wif_rng_com_s = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_s > wif_rng_com_cap } } set_variable = { wif_rng_com_s = wif_rng_com_cap } }
}

# RNG scope: the hideout moves (to another of its four regions).
wif_rng_com_move_base = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 606 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 749 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 615 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 607 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 749 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 606 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 615 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 607 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 615 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 606 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 749 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 607 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 607 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 606 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 749 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 615 } } } }
	else = { random_list = { 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 606 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 749 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 615 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = 607 } } } }
}

wif_rng_com_numbers = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 10 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 20 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 30 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 40 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 45 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 6 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 50 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 7 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 60 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 12 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 8 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 75 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 20 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 9 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 85 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 15 } }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 1 }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_railway_guards } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_tunnels } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 4 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_runaway_inflation } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 6 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_sabotage_schools } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 0.8 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 7 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_free_camps } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 0.75 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 7 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 8 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 9 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_mobile_warfare } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 0.9 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 8 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_base_areas } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 5 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 6 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 7 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 8 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 9 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_com_instructors } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 0.9 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_garrison_agreement } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_garrisoned } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 6 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_factory_guards } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.7 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 7 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_camp_guards } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.7 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 5 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 6 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 7 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 8 } check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 9 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_com_hasten } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 1.3 } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_rng_need min = 5 }
}

wif_rng_com_pick_plan = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_reach = wif_rng_com_r }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_reach = 4 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_reach = wif_rng_com_s }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 20 } } wif_rng_com_op_2_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 30 } } wif_rng_com_op_3_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 40 } } wif_rng_com_op_4_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 50 } } wif_rng_com_op_6_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 60 } } wif_rng_com_op_7_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 75 } } wif_rng_com_op_8_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 85 } } wif_rng_com_op_9_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 9 } }
	random_list = {
		55 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = wif_rng_best } }
		30 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = wif_rng_best } subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 } }
		15 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = wif_rng_best } subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 2 } }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rng_com_plan min = 1 max = 9 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan > 1 } NOT = { wif_rng_com_plan_ok = yes } }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_rng_com_pm = 0 }
}

# RNG scope: one month of this resistance.
wif_rng_com_month = {
	set_variable = { wif_rng_com_r = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_com_r = 1 } }
	add_to_variable = { wif_rng_com_r = wif_rng_com_g }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_quiet } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_com_r = -0.25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_bounties } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_com_r = 0.25 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_fund > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { wif_rng_com_r = 0.5 }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_com_fund = 1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rng_com_r min = 0 max = 20 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = wif_rng_com_r }
	wif_rng_com_add = yes
	random = { chance = 15 wif_rng_com_move_base = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_com_hiding } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan < 1 } NOT = { wif_rng_com_plan_ok = yes } } }
			wif_rng_com_pick_plan = yes
		}
		wif_rng_com_numbers = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_s < wif_rng_need } } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_com_s }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_need }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = 35 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_rng_chance min = 0 max = 85 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_mult }
			set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_rng_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_roll < wif_rng_chance } }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 1 }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_exec = wif_rng_com_plan }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 0 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = wif_rng_cost }
				wif_rng_com_add = yes
				wif_rng_execute = yes
				set_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { wif_rng_com_pm = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_pm > 3 } }
				subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 1 }
				clamp_variable = { var = wif_rng_com_plan min = 1 max = 9 }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_com_pm = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# RNG scope: a 30-day sweep of one state ends. Temp wif_rng_sweep_state = the state.
wif_rng_com_sweep_resolve = {
	clr_country_flag = wif_rng_sweep_running
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_com_base = wif_rng_sweep_state } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 55 }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_rng_reliable_few } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_rng_fourth_army } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 15 } }
		
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_shared_intel } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = -10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_com_known } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 10 } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_rng_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_roll < wif_rng_odds } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -12 } wif_rng_com_add = yes
			set_variable = { wif_rng_com_plan = 0 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = wif_rng_com_hiding days = 60 }
			wif_rng_com_move_base = yes
			clr_country_flag = wif_rng_com_known
			army_experience = 5
			country_event = { id = wif_chn.30 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -5 } wif_rng_com_add = yes
			wif_rng_com_move_base = yes
			clr_country_flag = wif_rng_com_known
			country_event = { id = wif_chn.31 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 1 }
		random_list = {
			40 = { set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -6 } wif_rng_com_add = yes army_experience = 3 country_event = { id = wif_chn.33 } }
			60 = { set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -2 } wif_rng_com_add = yes country_event = { id = wif_chn.32 } }
		}
	}
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Loyalist Army (kmt)
# RNG scope: strength += temp wif_rng_d, never below 10 or above the cap.
wif_rng_kmt_add = {
	add_to_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_s = wif_rng_d }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_s < 10 } } set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_s = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_s > wif_rng_kmt_cap } } set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_s = wif_rng_kmt_cap } }
}

# RNG scope: the hideout moves (to another of its four regions).
wif_rng_kmt_move_base = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 605 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 1041 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 603 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 602 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 1041 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 605 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 603 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 602 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 603 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 605 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 1041 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 602 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 602 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 605 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 1041 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 603 } } } }
	else = { random_list = { 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 605 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 1041 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 603 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = 602 } } } }
}

wif_rng_kmt_numbers = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 10 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 20 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 30 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 40 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 45 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 6 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 50 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 7 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 60 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 12 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 8 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 75 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 20 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 9 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 85 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 15 } }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 1 }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 1 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_railway_guards } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 4 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_runaway_inflation } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 3 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_nwa_saboteurs } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 0.8 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 6 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_kmt_instructors } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 0.9 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 5 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_nwa_assassins } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -15 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 5 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_kmt_silver } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 7 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_nwa_free_officers } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 0.75 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 8 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_nwa_loyalist_districts } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 1 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_garrison_agreement } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 1 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_garrisoned } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 6 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_factory_guards } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.7 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 7 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_camp_guards } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.7 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 1 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 5 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 6 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 7 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 8 } check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 9 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_kmt_hasten } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 1.3 } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_rng_need min = 5 }
}

	}

		subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_pm = 0 }
}

# RNG scope: one month of this resistance.
wif_rng_kmt_month = {
	set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_r = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_r = 1 } }
	add_to_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_r = wif_rng_kmt_g }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_quiet } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_r = -0.25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_bounties } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_r = 0.25 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_fund > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_r = 0.5 }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_fund = 1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rng_kmt_r min = 0 max = 20 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = wif_rng_kmt_r }
	wif_rng_kmt_add = yes
	random = { chance = 15 wif_rng_kmt_move_base = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_kmt_hiding } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan < 1 } NOT = { wif_rng_kmt_plan_ok = yes } } }
			wif_rng_kmt_pick_plan = yes
		}
		wif_rng_kmt_numbers = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_s < wif_rng_need } } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_kmt_s }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_need }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = 35 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_rng_chance min = 0 max = 85 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_mult }
			set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_rng_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_roll < wif_rng_chance } }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 2 }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_exec = wif_rng_kmt_plan }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 0 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = wif_rng_cost }
				wif_rng_kmt_add = yes
				wif_rng_execute = yes
				set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_pm = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_pm > 3 } }
				subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 1 }
				clamp_variable = { var = wif_rng_kmt_plan min = 1 max = 9 }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_pm = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# RNG scope: a 30-day sweep of one state ends. Temp wif_rng_sweep_state = the state.
wif_rng_kmt_sweep_resolve = {
	clr_country_flag = wif_rng_sweep_running
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_base = wif_rng_sweep_state } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 55 }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_rng_reliable_few } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 10 } }
		
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_rng_loyalist_hunt } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 15 } }
		
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_kmt_known } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 10 } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_rng_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_roll < wif_rng_odds } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -12 } wif_rng_kmt_add = yes
			set_variable = { wif_rng_kmt_plan = 0 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = wif_rng_kmt_hiding days = 60 }
			wif_rng_kmt_move_base = yes
			clr_country_flag = wif_rng_kmt_known
			army_experience = 5
			country_event = { id = wif_chn.30 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -5 } wif_rng_kmt_add = yes
			wif_rng_kmt_move_base = yes
			clr_country_flag = wif_rng_kmt_known
			country_event = { id = wif_chn.31 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 2 }
		random_list = {
			40 = { set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -6 } wif_rng_kmt_add = yes army_experience = 3 country_event = { id = wif_chn.33 } }
			60 = { set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -2 } wif_rng_kmt_add = yes country_event = { id = wif_chn.32 } }
		}
	}
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Chinese Liberation League (lib)
# RNG scope: strength += temp wif_rng_d, never below 10 or above the cap.
wif_rng_lib_add = {
	add_to_variable = { wif_rng_lib_s = wif_rng_d }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_s < 10 } } set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_s = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_s > wif_rng_lib_cap } } set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_s = wif_rng_lib_cap } }
}

# RNG scope: the hideout moves (to another of its four regions).
wif_rng_lib_move_base = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 325 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 751 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 620 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 744 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 751 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 325 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 620 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 744 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 620 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 325 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 751 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 744 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 744 } } random_list = { 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 325 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 751 } } 33 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 620 } } } }
	else = { random_list = { 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 325 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 751 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 620 } } 25 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = 744 } } } }
}

wif_rng_lib_numbers = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 10 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 3 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 2 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 20 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 4 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 30 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 6 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 4 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 40 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 8 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 5 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 45 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 6 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 50 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 10 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 7 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 60 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 12 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 8 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 75 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 20 } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 9 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 85 } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_cost = 15 } }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 1 }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_railway_guards } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = 10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 4 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_runaway_inflation } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 4 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_lib_organisers } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_need = -10 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_garrison_agreement } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 } } has_country_flag = wif_rng_garrisoned } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 6 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_factory_guards } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.7 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 7 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_camp_guards } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.7 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 5 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 6 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 7 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 8 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 9 } } has_completed_focus = wif_rng_liberation_infiltrate } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 0.85 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 2 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 3 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 4 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 5 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 6 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 7 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 8 } check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 9 } } has_global_flag = wif_chn_nwa_league_officers } multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_mult = 1.1 } }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_rng_need min = 5 }
}

wif_rng_lib_pick_plan = {
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_reach = wif_rng_lib_r }
	multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_reach = 4 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_reach = wif_rng_lib_s }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 20 } } wif_rng_lib_op_2_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 30 } } wif_rng_lib_op_3_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 40 } } wif_rng_lib_op_4_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 4 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 50 } } wif_rng_lib_op_6_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 6 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 60 } } wif_rng_lib_op_7_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 7 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 75 } } wif_rng_lib_op_8_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 8 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_reach < 85 } } wif_rng_lib_op_9_ok = yes } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_best = 9 } }
	random_list = {
		55 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = wif_rng_best } }
		30 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = wif_rng_best } subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 } }
		15 = { set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = wif_rng_best } subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 2 } }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rng_lib_plan min = 1 max = 9 }
	while_loop_effect = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan > 1 } NOT = { wif_rng_lib_plan_ok = yes } }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_pm = 0 }
}

# RNG scope: one month of this resistance.
wif_rng_lib_month = {
	set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_r = 1 }
	if = { limit = { has_war = yes } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_lib_r = 1 } }
	add_to_variable = { wif_rng_lib_r = wif_rng_lib_g }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_quiet } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_lib_r = -0.25 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_bounties } add_to_variable = { wif_rng_lib_r = 0.25 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_fund > 0 } }
		add_to_variable = { wif_rng_lib_r = 0.5 }
		subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_lib_fund = 1 }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = wif_rng_lib_r min = 0 max = 20 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = wif_rng_lib_r }
	wif_rng_lib_add = yes
	random = { chance = 15 wif_rng_lib_move_base = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_lib_hiding } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan < 1 } NOT = { wif_rng_lib_plan_ok = yes } } }
			wif_rng_lib_pick_plan = yes
		}
		wif_rng_lib_numbers = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_s < wif_rng_need } } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_lib_s }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_need }
			add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = 35 }
			clamp_temp_variable = { var = wif_rng_chance min = 0 max = 85 }
			multiply_temp_variable = { wif_rng_chance = wif_rng_mult }
			set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_rng_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_roll < wif_rng_chance } }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 3 }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_exec = wif_rng_lib_plan }
				set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 0 }
				subtract_from_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = wif_rng_cost }
				wif_rng_lib_add = yes
				wif_rng_execute = yes
				set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 0 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { wif_rng_lib_pm = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_pm > 3 } }
				subtract_from_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 1 }
				clamp_variable = { var = wif_rng_lib_plan min = 1 max = 9 }
				set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_pm = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# RNG scope: a 30-day sweep of one state ends. Temp wif_rng_sweep_state = the state.
wif_rng_lib_sweep_resolve = {
	clr_country_flag = wif_rng_sweep_running
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_base = wif_rng_sweep_state } }
		set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 55 }
		if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_rng_reliable_few } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 10 } }
		
		
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_shared_intel } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = -10 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_lib_known } add_to_temp_variable = { wif_rng_odds = 10 } }
		set_temp_variable_to_random = { var = wif_rng_roll min = 0 max = 100 }
		set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 3 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_roll < wif_rng_odds } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -12 } wif_rng_lib_add = yes
			set_variable = { wif_rng_lib_plan = 0 }
			set_country_flag = { flag = wif_rng_lib_hiding days = 60 }
			wif_rng_lib_move_base = yes
			clr_country_flag = wif_rng_lib_known
			army_experience = 5
			country_event = { id = wif_chn.30 }
		}
		else = {
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -5 } wif_rng_lib_add = yes
			wif_rng_lib_move_base = yes
			clr_country_flag = wif_rng_lib_known
			country_event = { id = wif_chn.31 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { wif_rng_last = 3 }
		random_list = {
			40 = { set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -6 } wif_rng_lib_add = yes army_experience = 3 country_event = { id = wif_chn.33 } }
			60 = { set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = -2 } wif_rng_lib_add = yes country_event = { id = wif_chn.32 } }
		}
	}
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the operations
# RNG scope; wif_rng_last = the group that struck (1 com, 2 kmt, 3 lib).
wif_rng_execute = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 1 } } wif_rng_op_1 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 2 } } wif_rng_op_2 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 3 } } wif_rng_op_3 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 4 } } wif_rng_op_4 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 5 } } wif_rng_op_5 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 6 } } wif_rng_op_6 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 7 } } wif_rng_op_7 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 8 } } wif_rng_op_8 = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_exec = 9 } } wif_rng_op_9 = yes }
	# One Front Behind the Lines: Communists and League feed each other
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_one_front
			check_variable = { wif_rng_com_s > 39.9 }
			check_variable = { wif_rng_lib_s > 39.9 }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 1 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 2 } wif_rng_lib_add = yes }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 3 } } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 2 } wif_rng_com_add = yes }
	}
}

# RNG scope: the group that struck (wif_rng_last) gains temp wif_rng_d.
wif_rng_last_add = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 1 } } wif_rng_com_add = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 2 } } wif_rng_kmt_add = yes }
	else = { wif_rng_lib_add = yes }
}

# RNG scope: freed people go north (temp wif_rng_freed = 1 small, 2 large).
wif_rng_freed_go = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_underground
			country_exists = PRC
			OR = {
				check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 1 }
				AND = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 3 } check_variable = { global.wif_league_allegiance > 49.9 } }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_freed = 2 } } PRC = { add_manpower = 3000 } }
		else = { PRC = { add_manpower = 1000 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = wif_chn_nwa_free_officers
			country_exists = CHI
			OR = {
				check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 2 }
				AND = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 3 } check_variable = { global.wif_league_allegiance < -49.9 } }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_freed = 2 } } CHI = { add_manpower = 3000 } }
		else = { CHI = { add_manpower = 1000 } }
	}
}

wif_rng_op_1 = {
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT infrastructure > 0 }
		save_event_target_as = wif_rng_attack_state
		damage_building = { type = infrastructure damage = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_river_patrol } } add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rng_sabotage_idea days = 30 } }
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.11 }
}
wif_rng_op_2 = {
	add_manpower = -3000
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 2 } wif_rng_last_add = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_freed = 1 } wif_rng_freed_go = yes
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.12 }
}
wif_rng_op_3 = {
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = { OR = { state = 620 state = 600 state = 325 state = 615 } is_controlled_by = ROOT }
		save_event_target_as = wif_rng_attack_state
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = wif_rng_mine_wrecked days = 60 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 2 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 1 } has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_strike_mines } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 3 } }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 2 } has_global_flag = wif_chn_nwa_saboteurs } set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 3 } }
	wif_rng_decay_add = yes
	if = { limit = { country_exists = JAP } JAP = { add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_jap_mine_shortfall_idea days = 60 } } }
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.13 }
}
wif_rng_op_4 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_rng_mitsubishi_wuhan owns_state = 1036 }
		1036 = { save_event_target_as = wif_rng_attack_state }
	}
	else = {
		random_owned_state = { limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { industrial_complex > 0 arms_factory > 0 } } save_event_target_as = wif_rng_attack_state }
	}
	add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rng_strike_idea days = 60 }
	add_stability = -0.02
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.14 }
}
wif_rng_op_5 = {
	random_character = {
		limit = { is_political_advisor = yes }
		remove_advisor_role = { slot = political_advisor }
	}
	add_stability = -0.02
	add_political_power = -25
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.15 }
}
wif_rng_op_6 = {
	random_owned_state = {
		limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT OR = { industrial_complex > 0 arms_factory > 0 } }
		save_event_target_as = wif_rng_attack_state
		if = { limit = { arms_factory > 0 } damage_building = { type = arms_factory damage = 1 } }
		else = { damage_building = { type = industrial_complex damage = 1 } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 3 } wif_rng_decay_add = yes
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.16 }
}
wif_rng_op_7 = {
	add_manpower = -10000
	add_stability = -0.03
	add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rng_breakout_idea days = 90 }
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 5 } wif_rng_last_add = yes
	set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_freed = 2 } wif_rng_freed_go = yes
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.17 }
}
wif_rng_op_8 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 1 } }
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 606 state = 749 state = 615 state = 607 } is_controlled_by = ROOT NOT = { is_capital = yes } }
			save_event_target_as = wif_rng_attack_state
			set_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now } }
			start_civil_war = {
				ideology = communism
				size = 0.03
				army_ratio = 0.05
				states = all
				states_filter = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now }
				keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
				keep_political_leader = yes
				keep_political_party_members = yes
				set_country_flag = wif_rng_rebels_com
				set_cosmetic_tag = wif_chn_rebels_com
				set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
				set_popularities = { communism = 80 neutrality = 20 }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 2000 }
			}
		}
		every_state = { limit = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now } clr_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 2 } }
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 605 state = 1041 state = 603 state = 602 } is_controlled_by = ROOT NOT = { is_capital = yes } }
			save_event_target_as = wif_rng_attack_state
			set_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now } }
			start_civil_war = {
				ideology = fascism
				size = 0.03
				army_ratio = 0.05
				states = all
				states_filter = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now }
				keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
				keep_political_leader = yes
				keep_political_party_members = yes
				set_country_flag = wif_rng_rebels_kmt
				set_cosmetic_tag = wif_chn_rebels_kmt
				set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
				set_popularities = { neutrality = 80 fascism = 20 }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 2000 }
			}
		}
		every_state = { limit = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now } clr_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { wif_rng_last = 3 } }
		random_owned_state = {
			limit = { OR = { state = 325 state = 751 state = 620 state = 744 } is_controlled_by = ROOT NOT = { is_capital = yes } }
			save_event_target_as = wif_rng_attack_state
			set_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now
		}
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_state = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now } }
			start_civil_war = {
				ideology = democratic
				size = 0.03
				army_ratio = 0.05
				states = all
				states_filter = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now }
				keep_unit_leaders_trigger = { always = yes }
				keep_political_leader = yes
				keep_political_party_members = yes
				set_country_flag = wif_rng_rebels_lib
				set_cosmetic_tag = wif_chn_rebels_lib
				set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no }
				set_popularities = { democratic = 80 neutrality = 20 }
				add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 2000 }
			}
		}
		every_state = { limit = { has_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now } clr_state_flag = wif_rng_liberate_now }
	}
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.18 }
}
wif_rng_op_9 = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = JAP }
		JAP = {
			add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_jap_convoys_hit_idea days = 60 }
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = -1000 }
			add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = wif_chn_jap_op_m10 }
		}
	}
	country_event = { id = wif_chn.19 }
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- monthly
# on_monthly_RNG
wif_rng_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_tree }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_total_mob NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_bailout } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 0.5 } wif_rng_decay_add = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = wif_chn_prc_economic_war NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_bailout } }
			set_temp_variable = { wif_rng_d = 0.25 } wif_rng_decay_add = yes
		}
		wif_rng_hollow_update = yes
		wif_rng_com_month = yes
		wif_rng_kmt_month = yes
		wif_rng_lib_month = yes
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_secret_letters NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_letters_found } }
			random = { chance = 2 set_country_flag = wif_rng_letters_found country_event = { id = wif_chn.61 } }
		}
		wif_chn_refresh = yes
	}
}

# on_monthly_JAP
wif_jap_china_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = RNG RNG = { has_country_flag = wif_rng_tree } }
		wif_jap_china_update = yes
	}
}

# on_monthly_PRC
wif_prc_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_prc_tree }
		if = {
			limit = { has_completed_focus = wif_prc_joint_funding has_variable = global.wif_league_allegiance }
			multiply_variable = { global.wif_league_allegiance = 0.95 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { wif_prc_blockade_held = yes has_idea = wif_prc_blockade_1 }
			swap_ideas = { remove_idea = wif_prc_blockade_1 add_idea = wif_prc_blockade_2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_prc_counteroffensive has_global_flag = wif_rng_collapse_begun NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_prc_counter_given } }
			set_country_flag = wif_prc_counter_given
			add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_prc_counter_idea days = 365 }
		}
	}
}

# on_monthly_CHI
wif_nwa_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_nwa_tree }
		add_to_variable = { wif_nwa_months = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_nwa_months > 11 } }
			set_variable = { wif_nwa_months = 0 }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_nwa_tibet_road owns_state = 752 } add_equipment_to_stockpile = { type = infantry_equipment amount = 500 producer = ROOT } }
			if = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_nwa_officer_routes } create_corps_commander = { name = "A Returning Officer" skill = 2 attack_skill = 2 defense_skill = 2 planning_skill = 1 logistics_skill = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = wif_nwa_counteroffensive has_global_flag = wif_rng_collapse_begun NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_nwa_counter_given } }
			set_country_flag = wif_nwa_counter_given
			add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_nwa_counter_idea days = 365 }
		}
	}
}
